panels.title: Sessions (click session_id to drill down)
panels.description: Sessions that had at least one model request (the same rule as the Sessions card on Overview and the Session variable). Sessions with only startup events or a local command are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT session_id, started, project, host, account,
       if(title != '', title, leftUTF8(replaceAll(first_prompt, '\n', ' '), 120)) AS name, git_branch,
       prompts, round(cost_usd, 3) AS cost_usd, tokens, tool_calls, agents_run, skills_run,
       dateDiff('minute', started, last_event) AS minutes
FROM cc.sessions
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
  AND requests > 0
  AND started >= $__fromTime AND started <= $__toTime
ORDER BY started DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Prompts in the selected session
panels.description: Select one session in the variable above (or click a session_id).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT min(ts) AS time,
       leftUTF8(replaceAll(anyIf(prompt, event = 'user_prompt'), '\n', ' '), 160) AS prompt,
       round(sumIf(cost_usd, event = 'api_request'), 3) AS cost_usd,
       sumIf(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens, event = 'api_request') AS tokens,
       countIf(event = 'tool_result') AS tool_calls,
       countIf(event = 'subagent_completed') AS agents,
       arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(skill_name, event = 'skill_activated'), ', ') AS skills
FROM cc.events
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND '${session}' != '__all' AND prompt_id != ''
GROUP BY prompt_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Session timeline: prompts, requests and tool calls
panels.description: Select one session in the variable above. Every prompt, model request and tool call of the session in time order (newest 1000 in the range). Prompts are shown only when Actor and Skill are All; prompt text exists only when the client logs prompts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, kind, actor, what, tokens, round(cost_usd, 4) AS cost_usd, duration_ms, status
FROM
(
  SELECT ts AS time, 'prompt' AS kind, 'main' AS actor, leftUTF8(replaceAll(prompt, '\n', ' '), 200) AS what,
         toUInt64(0) AS tokens, toFloat64(0) AS cost_usd, toUInt64(0) AS duration_ms, '' AS status
  FROM cc.events
  WHERE event = 'user_prompt' AND '${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all'
    AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts, 'request', actor, model, total_tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms, ''
  FROM cc.api_requests
  WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
    AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts, 'tool', actor, if(path != '', concat(tool_name, ' ', path), tool_name), toUInt64(0), toFloat64(0), duration_ms, if(success, 'ok', 'failed')
  FROM cc.tool_calls
  WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
    AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
)
WHERE '${session}' != '__all'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Cumulative cost over the session (pick a session)
panels.description: Running total of cost_usd (computed by Claude Code, API-equivalent) over the selected session, one point per model request. Empty while Session = All: select one session in the Session variable above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.1 AS time, t.2 AS cost_usd
FROM
(
  SELECT arrayJoin(arrayZip(arrayMap(x -> x.1, s), arrayCumSum(arrayMap(x -> x.2, s)))) AS t
  FROM
  (
    SELECT arraySort(groupArray((ts, cost_usd))) AS s
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
      AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')
      AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND '${session}' != '__all'
  )
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cumulative tokens over the session (pick a session)
panels.description: Running total of all tokens (input + output + cache read + cache create) over the selected session. Cache read dominates the total. Empty while Session = All: select one session in the Session variable above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.1 AS time, t.2 AS tokens
FROM
(
  SELECT arrayJoin(arrayZip(arrayMap(x -> x.1, s), arrayCumSum(arrayMap(x -> x.2, s)))) AS t
  FROM
  (
    SELECT arraySort(groupArray((ts, total_tokens))) AS s
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
      AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')
      AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND '${session}' != '__all'
  )
)
ORDER BY time
